item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Speaks as Attacks Rattle Energy Markets
item.summary: The president was answering questions at an appearance with the Japanese prime minister, as energy prices soar because of new strikes against oil and gas facilities in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: The Iran War’s Economic Threat to Europe and Asia
item.summary: Inflation and its consequences for growth are a growing concern for countries where memories of the 2022 energy crisis are fresh.

item.title: Trump and Iran Dominate the Agenda as Europe’s Leaders Meet. Here Are 4 Things to Know.
item.summary: A gathering in Brussels was meant to concentrate on jump-starting the E.U. economy. Instead, the fallout of the war in the Middle East is front and center.

item.title: A Lebanese Cafe on the Edge of Destruction
item.summary: Near the center of Beirut, one image captures the aftermath of an Israeli strike.

item.title: Contradicting Trump, Israeli Officials Say U.S. Was Told about South Pars Attack
item.summary: President Trump said the United States “knew nothing” about an attack on the gas field in Iran, which sent global oil and gas prices soaring.

item.title: Father of a Palestinian woman killed with three others during a missile attack expresses shock.
item.summary: The victims are the first Palestinians in the Israeli-occupied West Bank to be killed as a result of the Middle East war.

item.title: Pentagon Seeks Additional $200 Billion to Fund Iran War
item.summary: The request, which the White House has not submitted to Congress, is already encountering some resistance.

item.title: Why Iran’s Attack on an Energy Hub in Qatar Spooked Investors
item.summary: Lasting damage to Ras Laffan Industrial City, the world’s largest liquefied natural gas export plant, would have big consequences for the global energy market.

item.title: The Soldier Who Came Back From the Dead
item.summary: Told that Nazar Daletskyi had died, his Ukrainian family buried what they thought were his remains. He turned up three years later in a prisoner-of-war exchange.

item.title: 2 Men Charged With Spying for Iran on Jewish Institutions in UK
item.summary: The men, both Iranian citizens, are accused of conducting surveillance on several Jewish institutions and community buildings in London.
